news.title: Preserving Jobs and Tax Revenue in the Age of AI: Q&A with Carter Price
news.summary_en: Carter Price, a mathematician at RAND and co-director of the RAND Von Furstenberg Family Budget Model Initiative, discusses ways to rebalance the tax code so that it doesn't incentivize employers to replace humans with AI.

news.title: Legal and Clinical Liability of Comanaging Pediatric Mental Health With Unregulated AI Chatbots: Reply
news.summary_en: We conclude that parents and clinicians should proactively discuss chatbot use to promote safety, appropriate expectations, and linkages to evidence-based care.

news.title: Data Center Siting Model and Suitability Mapper for Community Planners: Overview and Technical Documentation
news.summary_en: This document offers an overview and technical documentation for the Data Center Siting Model and Suitability Mapper for Community Planners, a tool to support state and local decisionmakers considering the benefits and costs of siting a data center.

news.title: Optimizing Data Center Siting: Considering Local Infrastructure, Environmental, and Community Constraints
news.summary_en: The Data Center Suitability Mapper for Community Planners provides local and state government decisionmakers and other industry stakeholders with data and visualizations to compare trade-offs among locations for regional data centers.

news.title: The Insurability of Artificial Intelligence
news.summary_en: A mismatch exists between rapid enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) and the market for insuring it. This report examines AI incidents, lawsuits, laws, and insurance filings to assess coverage responses and accumulation risks.

news.title: A U.S. Strategy to Secure Geopolitical Advantage on an Uncertain Path to Superintelligence: Maintaining Freedom of Action
news.summary_en: Frontier artificial intelligence continues to advance, and many experts contend that superintelligence is possible. The authors recommend a Freedom of Action strategy to secure geopolitical advantage and ensure humanity’s survival with agency.
